paragraphs: Rav Chinena bar Kahana, in R. Elazar's name: Shabbat 96a. “R. Ashi said”—Eruvin 55b. R. Chinena bar Kahana: Rosh Hashanah 32a. There, 19b, “Rabbi said” should read “Rav said”; so too Beitzah 6a. “They say in Rav's school”—Avodah Zarah 20b. “R. Chinena bar Kahana said: Shmuel said”—Bava Kamma 113a. That matter in Nedarim 28a, “R. Chinena said: R. Kahana said: Shmuel said,” is a scribal error and should read “R. Chinena bar Kahana said.” In Shmuel's name: Taanit 30a. “Shmuel said”—Ketubot 65a, 72a; Rosh Hashanah 29a; Beitzah 6a, 22b.
